title: Apparatus Signals
summary: Which fire departments are about to sell a truck, in all 50 states: grants, orders, board votes and auction lots read into one ranked list, with a likely listing month and a guide price for each.

title: The cup note
summary: A Simile-style simulation of Starbucks' handwritten cup-note policy: one rule, 24 ways it plays out across managers, baristas and customers before anyone rolls it out. Synthetic, precomputed.

title: Rumor Town
summary: Start one rumor in a pixel-art town of 50 people and watch it spread, change, get doubted, and get set straight over one day.

title: The war premium
summary: An interactive chart of the Brent–WTI spread, 2021 to 2026 — what the market charges for war risk, in dollars per barrel.
